r.description: Route 61 travels from Maidenhead to Hatfield, Welwyn Garden City and Hertford before arriving near Hoddesdon.

r.name: Greenwich Meridian Trail
r.description: A long-distance walk that follows the line of the Prime Meridian. Inaugurated in 2009, to coincide with the 125th anniversary of the Greenwich Meridian.

r.name: EuroVelo 2 - Capitals Route - part United Kingdom 7
r.name:fr: EuroVelo 2 - La route des capitales - part Royaume-Uni 7

r.description: National Cycle Network link route between NCN 1 and RCN 50

r.name: Capability Brown Walk, Hatfield Forest
r.description: Circular trail explores the Georgian highlights of Hatfield Forest and influences of architect Capability Brown. Mostly level ground, some tree routes and gates. Paths can get muddy. Dogs on leads near livestock and around the lake.

r.name: Hatfield Forest Walk, Hatfield Forest
r.description: Circular walk around the lake and then through the forest. Paths can get muddy after wet weather. Dogs welcome, please keep dogs on lead near livestock and around the lake.

r.name: Hatfield Forest and Flitch Way Walk, Hatfield Forest
r.description: Circular family walk, through medieval hunting forest full of ancient trees. Terrain is flat. Paths can get muddy. Dogs on leads near livestock and around the lake.

r.name: Hatfield Forest Buttercup Walk, Hatfield Forest
r.description: Trail takes you through the best places to see buttercups in May or June. Mostly level ground through grassy plains and woodland paths, some tree routes and gates. Paths can get muddy. Dogs on leads near livestock and around the lake.

r.name: Hatfield Forest Tree Walk, Hatfield Forest
r.description: Flat route on boarded or site roads, take care when crossing or walking on roads. Dogs welcome, please keep dogs on lead near livestock and around the lake.

r.name: Takeley to Wall Wood Circular Walk, Hatfield Forest
r.description: Circular walk in Takeley, Essex. Several stiles, tree roots, ditches and footbridges. Can get muddy in wet weather, wear appropriate clothing and footwear. Dogs on leads around the lake.
